name: appmixer.bigCommerce
label: BigCommerce
description: BigCommerce Admin APIs for Products (v3), Customers (v3), Orders (v2), and Webhooks (v3). Base URL: https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/{store_hash}/. Use headers X-Auth-Token and X-Auth-Client on every request. Typical max page size is 250 for list/find endpoints; connector deliberately fetches only the first page. Rate limiting: observe headers X-Rate-Limit-Requests-Left and X-Rate-Limit-Time-Reset-MS and back off accordingly.

rateLimiting.notes: Respect remaining quota and reset time; implement retries with exponential backoff.
